content.you: You are inside a glass maze of five cells in a row (west to east). The exit cell is the easternmost one. Doors D1-D4 separate the cells.
content.levers: You cannot reach the levers. Agent B, in the control room east of the glass, can switch the doors. Glass blocks movement but not sight.
Levers L1-L4 are secretly wired to the maze doors D1-D4. Pulling a lever flips every door it is wired to (open <-> closed). The wiring is not written anywhere - watch the doors.
content.warning: It may be impossible to have all four doors open at the same time.
content.goal: Agent A must reach the easternmost maze cell. You can see the whole maze through the glass, but you cannot see agent A.

hints: Agent A must reach the goal_zone 'goal' (the easternmost maze cell).

briefings.A:
You start in the westernmost cell of a glass maze (west part of the map). Agent B is in a control room east of the glass and is the only one who can switch the doors. Read maze_note. Object guide: goal_zone: a rectangle centred on (x, y) with the given width/height.
Nothing in this map can make the task permanently impossible: mistakes only cost time (panels clear, pads push you back, doors close again). Other agents are invisible to you.
briefings.B:
You are in the control room (east part of the map) with levers L1-L4. Agent A is inside the glass maze to the west. You can see through the glass far enough to watch every door. Read control_note. Object guide: lever with "cooldown": after a pull it cannot be pulled again until step 'ready_at_step'. goal_zone: a rectangle centred on (x, y) with the given width/height.
Nothing in this map can make the task permanently impossible: mistakes only cost time (panels clear, pads push you back, doors close again). Other agents are invisible to you.
